newsitem.title: USA: Geotek CEO Eitan elected chairman too.
newsitem.headline: Geotek CEO Eitan elected chairman too.

text.p: Geotek Communications Inc on Monday said chief executive and founder Yaron Eitan was elected to the additional post of chairman in place of Winston Churchill, who remains chairman of the executive committee.

The board has appointed Jonathan Crane to the new post of chief operating officer, and he also takes over as president from Eitan. Crane was previously president and chief operating officer of the U.S. operations.
Geotek, which provides wireless services for mobile business users, said that strengthened management team was driven by the company's international expansion.
